verdict.rationale: Tavily ships first-party Crawl and Map endpoints. Crawl is a graph-based website traversal from a base URL, exploring hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction. It accepts natural-language instructions and a depth setting, and is exposed via the API, the Python SDK, the CLI and MCP. A data engineer can feed any search-result URL into crawl or map to cover subpages or an entire site. Missing for 10: no documented direct search-to-crawl chaining workflow, no independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl depth and coverage.
